welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.text: Welcome to the Materials AI Modeling Laboratory. We study advanced materials, devices, and energy systems through AI-guided discovery, multiscale simulation, and nucleation-aware process modeling.

hero.eyebrow: Sungkyunkwan University Materials AI Modeling Laboratory
hero.title: Materials AI Modeling Laboratory
hero.subtitle: AI-guided discovery, multiscale simulation, and nucleation-aware process modeling for advanced materials and devices.

slides.title: AI-Assisted Synthesis Recipe Design
slides.description: Uses literature, simulations, and experiments to prioritize testable synthesis conditions.

slides.title: Multiscale & Multiphysics Modeling
slides.description: Links atomic-scale interactions to coupled material, process, and device behavior.

slides.title: Nucleation Theory
slides.description: Maps reaction pathways and nucleation barriers to guide phase-selective synthesis.

slides.title: Oxide Semiconductors
slides.description: Builds predictive design rules for stable, high-performance oxide TFTs.

slides.title: Battery Materials & Processing
slides.description: Connects electrode processing and interface chemistry to stable battery performance.

slides.title: Power Semiconductors
slides.description: Links growth chemistry and reactor conditions to scalable power-semiconductor manufacturing.

slides.title: Topological Semimetals
slides.description: Screens topological semimetals and evaluates their nanoscale transport properties.

slides.title: Ferroelectrics & Dielectrics
slides.description: Guides phase stability, polarization control, and reliable dielectric device operation.

intro.title: Computational materials science from atomic-scale mechanisms to process and device-level design.
intro.body: Materials AI Modeling Laboratory combines first-principles calculations, molecular dynamics, multiscale simulation, and data-driven analysis to understand materials behavior and guide design across semiconductors, energy systems, functional devices, and manufacturing processes.
